_comment: SH1315 — what each curator task costs in the console today. clicks, keys and screens gate at the measurement with no headroom; ms is printed and never gated. Re-record with `node e2e/curator-tasks.mjs --record`, which keeps each why. A task a filed defect stops is `blocked` until it completes.

change-headline.why: The headline is the hero section's, so the path is search → section → field → Actions → Publish → confirm. Since SH1323 the page's section list opens the section too, at the same cost, and the section's editor previews the page it is on.

approve-run.why: Home names the waiting run and the queue approves in one press, with no confirmation: the reference for what a curator decision can cost.

replace-image.why: A filled image field opens the picker on its own folder, so a replace is search → Search → file → Select → publish. Since SH1325 an empty field opens beside the post too, and a folder opens on one click.

find-page.why: Ctrl+K, the title, and the page's own row, which since SH1394 opens it in the Universal Editor on itself: the floor every other task's first step is measured against. Its form is the Edit fields row beside it.

create-page.why: SH1338: Ctrl+K offers New page in <site> when the reader has one site, which opens that site's page form; the form publishes (SH1326), so the rest is Publish… and the confirmation. Before it, four of six screens were the way to the form: Content, the hub, the Sites card, the site.

preview-draft.why: The draft only exists as a draft, which is the case a preview is for. Search, the result, Preview: the second screen is the preview's own tab. It was Spring's 404 on any site whose name needs encoding until SH1322.

change-headline-ue.why: SH1394: Ctrl+K, Pricing's own row (a page opens in the Universal Editor), the heading replaced the way the form task replaces its field, Publish, on one screen: two clicks fewer than the form. It was 6 clicks over 4 screens while the editor opened only on a site's home (SH1319).

replace-image-ue.why: SH1393: Ctrl+K, Pricing's own row, the image, Search in the panel, the file, Select, Publish: one click fewer than the form. It was blocked while the panel drew the image widget read-only (SH1037), and the widget showed an empty upload box because the page reports the element, not the file id.

preview-draft-ue.why: SH1394: Ctrl+K and the draft's own row, which opens the Universal Editor on it as the visitor will see it: one click and one screen fewer than the form's preview. It was blocked while the editor opened only on a site's home, which no draft is linked from (SH1392).

change-description.why: SH1399: Ctrl+K, the page's Edit fields row, the description replaced, then Actions, Publish and the confirmation (P7). The field is metadata, drawn by no element, so the form was the only place it could be edited.

change-description-ue.why: SH1399: Ctrl+K, the page's own row, Fields, the description replaced, Publish: the form drawn beside the page and saved with its other changes, one click fewer than the form, whose Publish asks for a confirmation.
